subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 06/10] nfsdctl: clear rpcbind entries when the serv is torn down

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl utility to clear rpcbind entries when the NFS server is torn down. The previous behavior was inconsistent, as some paths cleared these entries while others did not. The patch fixes this by adding a check for zero threads in all pools and clearing the rpcbind entries if so. This ensures that the rpcbind entries are properly cleaned up even when the server is shut down unexpectedly or due to listener failures.
